value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER or call 911. Fever with a stiff neck, bad headache, and pain from light can be signs of meningitis, which needs urgent treatment.
value.triage: Do not wait or call 811 for this - go to the ER immediately or call 911, especially if you also see a rash that does not fade when pressed, drowsiness, confusion, or vomiting. Get seen right away.
